item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery

Hello everyone! The version of ContraZ on GameMaps had been left abandoned and outdated at v0.5, while the Steam version continued to evolve. I’m happy to announce that I’ve worked on the campaign to bring the **latest version (v0.7)** directly here—fully ready for you to enjoy. Furthermore, I will be providing **ongoing support** and updates to ensure the best possible gameplay experience. Enjoy this release, inspired by *Contra*, and please don’t hesitate to leave your feedback or report any issues!

item.title: [ Mod ] [KabalMystic] KM Tawna Bandicoot (Ellis) (L4D Styled VGUI)
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 4
A personal custom-edited mod of 7EMP3ST model port mod of Tawna Bandicoot's model by KabalMystic for Ellis. It alters the VGUI/HUD icons (the Lobby, Panel, and Incap icons) to a cleaner L4D-styled look. I made this edit cuz while the original VGUI portraits that come with the original model of the mod are not bad by any stretch, but they don't match the portraits that come with the majority of skin mods from other modders. Something to point out is that it also includes the model itself unmodified, since there's no way for me to just upload the portraits without there being a compatibility error. Features from original mod: - World Model - Viewmodel/FP Arms - Facial flex - Eye tracking - Custom bile - Jigglebones - Support reskin New Features: - New HUD/VGUI Icons Original Mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3456069528 ___________________________________________________ Credits: Model by KabalMystic 7EMPEST/Tempest - Original mod creator BoatGod_Kenny - Remade Lobby, Panel, and Incap VGUI/HUD icons plus texture fixes. Tawna Bandicoot is from "Crash Bandicoot"
